steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the Odoo app at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ using login admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; verify the authenticated app is open and report the page/title or user indication.
02-create: Create a customer contact named '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with City set to Benchville. Save it, then verify the saved customer record/list showing the exact name and city.

03-create: Create a new quotation for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with exactly one order line: choose any product from the product catalogue and set quantity 3. Save the quotation without confirming. Verify and report the chosen product name, its displayed unit price, the untaxed amount, and that there is only one line.

04-add: On quotation {{03-create.ref_3}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer', add a second order line using a different catalogue product than {{03-create.product_name}} and set its quantity to 2. Save while keeping the quotation unconfirmed. Verify the second product and the new untaxed amount.

05-change: On quotation {{03-create.ref_3}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer', change the first line ({{03-create.product_name}}) quantity from 3 to 5, leaving the second line unchanged. Save without confirming and verify both quantities and the resulting untaxed amount.
06-verify: Confirm quotation {{03-create.ref_3}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer' so it becomes a sales order. Verify the order reference and the status shown after confirmation.

07-verify: Cancel sales order {{03-create.ref_3}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer' so the order created in this run is no longer active. Handle any confirmation dialog if shown, then verify the final status shown on the record.
